plan.summary: This 4-week block fits an off-camp 12-week boxing plan with endurance as the main goal while keeping enough strength and power work to support punching, posture, and durability. Week 1 establishes simple baselines on the two main lifts so later work can stay controlled and repeatable. The main program starts in Week 2, with low-complexity power first, then basic strength, then short accessories and dedicated conditioning that does not interfere too much with sparring.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build an aerobic base and repeatable work capacity while establishing simple strength and power habits.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress conditioning density and basic strength without adding unnecessary fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep the engine built, sharpen speed and snap, and stay fresh enough for high-quality boxing work.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump fast and land quietly. Reset between reps so every jump stays crisp.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low box and step down each rep.

exercises.name: 2. Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few easy sets, then build to your heaviest clean set of 5. Keep the torso tall and stop before form breaks. This gives us a safe baseline for the next block.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log your top set load and reps.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 5. Log the load and reps so later weeks can progress from this baseline.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the goblet load is too light to challenge you.

exercises.name: 3a. One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Pull the elbow toward the hip and keep the torso still.

substitutionOptions.name: Backpack Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a loaded backpack if dumbbell load is limited.

exercises.name: 3b. Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Move under control and keep the ribs down at the top.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Floor Crunch
substitutionOptions.notes: Hold the load over the chest and keep the low back quiet.

exercises.name: 4. Brisk Walk or Easy Jog
exercises.notes: Build easy aerobic work without adding much soreness.

endurancePrescription.notes: Stay relaxed and nose-breath when possible.

substitutionOptions.name: Explosive Push-Up to Elevated Surface
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a bench, couch, or sturdy box if no ball is available.

exercises.name: 2. Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few easy sets, then build to your heaviest clean set of 5. Pause lightly on the floor and drive up hard. This gives us a safe baseline for the next block.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log your top set load and reps.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 5. Log the load and reps so later weeks can progress from this baseline.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Elevate the hands if needed to keep reps clean.

exercises.name: 3a. Half-Kneeling One-Arm Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Squeeze the glute on the kneeling side and press straight up.

substitutionOptions.name: Standing One-Arm Dumbbell Press

exercises.name: 3b. Suitcase Carry
exercises.notes: Stand tall and do not lean toward the weight.

substitutionOptions.name: Suitcase Hold
substitutionOptions.notes: Hold for 20-30 seconds each side if space is limited.

exercises.notes: Steady bag or shadowboxing rounds to build repeatable boxing conditioning without turning it into a brawl.
